subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
3.  
What will be the special bonus to Direct Employees? 
(A)  
` 28,00,000 
(B)  
` 12,00,000 
(C)  
` 16,00,000 
(D)  
` 15,00,000 
 
3
suggested_answer: (C) ` 16,00,000 Special Bonus (Direct Employees) 115% of standard = 20,000 × 115% = 23,000 tonnes 2 Eligible production = 27,000 − 23,000 = 4,000 tonnes Bonus = 4,000 × 400 = ` 16,00,000
